project_title: ISRO AI/ML Intelligent Dead Reckoning Navigation System (IO-VNBD Dataset)
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & TACTICAL AEROSPACE MINIMALISM

design_philosophy.emotional_archetype: Tactical Aerospace Precision & Mission-Critical Reliability (ISRO Focus)
core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix aerospace telemetry HUD styling with Swiss data density and clean modern react components
Content is King: Treat IMU sensor telemetry (accel, gyro, mag) and spatial dead reckoning paths with cinematic mission control seriousness
Tactical Negative Space & Contrast: Use 1px sharp borders, subtle slate glows, and high-visibility status indicators instead of soft commercial gradients
Dense Data Scanability: Mode B Bento Grid with 10 Hz simulation capabilities, live drift indicators, trajectory canvas, and real-time model metrics

typography.body_font: IBM Plex Sans, DM Sans, sans-serif
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight font-heading text-slate-100
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-100
hierarchy.caption_overline: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-cyan-400 font-semibold

rules: Containers with borders must include p-5 or p-6 padding to prevent text collision
Grid children must be direct children; if using motion.div, it must host grid span classes
Align interactive controls with left padding optical alignment
Leaflet map container must have full height inside its grid cell (min-h-[480px])

header_nav.style: Glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/80 border-b border-slate-800 z-50 sticky top-0
elements: ISRO NavIC logo badge with glowing green pulse indicator
Navigation tabs: [Overview / CSV Data / ML Model / DR Simulation / Trajectory Map / AI Report]
Dataset selector (IO-VNBD S-S1 + V-S1 preset or custom upload)
Quick status telemetry indicator (GPS Status: Normal / Blackout)

hero_banner.style: Tactical telemetry header with background grid overlay, mission statement, ISRO problem context, and quick-action run trigger
hero_banner.tagline: AI/ML Intelligent Dead Reckoning System for Seamless Navigation in GPS-Denied Environments

csv_uploader_panel.style: Dropzone with dual file handles (Smartphone IMU S-S1.csv + Vehicle GT V-S1.csv), instant parsing, column mapping check, sample pre-loader button

sensor_timeseries_chart.style: Multi-axis sync Recharts/Canvas with Accel (ax, ay, az), Gyro (wx, wy, wz), Mag, and GPS velocity overlays with windowing sliders

ml_training_panel.style: RandomForest / XGBoost regressor setup for velocity estimation from IMU sliding windows. Live epoch/tree training animation, feature importance bar chart, validation MAE & RMSE metrics

dead_reckoning_sim_control.style: Interactive slider & numeric inputs for GPS blackout window selection (e.g. t=120s to t=240s), filter selector (EKF vs UKF vs ML-fused), real-time 10 Hz replay toggle

leaflet_trajectory_map.style: Custom Dark Tile Layer OpenStreetMap / CartoDB Dark Matter. Polyline overlays for Ground Truth (Orange #F97316), INS Raw DR (Purple #A855F7), Fused ML+Kalman DR (Cyan #06B6D4), with translucent red Polygon for Blackout zone and live animated marker icon

drift_metrics_dashboard.style: Grid of high-impact stat cards: Final Position Drift Error (m & % of trajectory distance), Horizontal RMSE (m), Peak Error (m), GPS-Denied Duration (s), Update Frequency (10 Hz)

ai_summary_panel.style: Terminal-style card with markdown stream explanation of navigation performance, failure modes during blackout, filter convergence analysis, and ISRO mission readiness rating

motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion CSS media query across all charts and map animations

instructions_to_main_agent: Load dataset presets (IO-VNBD S-S1 smartphone IMU & V-S1 vehicle ground truth) seamlessly if user clicks 'Load IO-VNBD Demo Dataset'.

Build a robust client-side or FastAPI backend pipeline for sliding window feature extraction (accel magnitude, gyro norm, pitch/roll tilt, variance) -> train scikit-learn RandomForest model for speed prediction -> integrate INS dead reckoning equations (v * dt, heading update) -> EKF/UKF filter fusion.
Implement real-time Leaflet trajectory plot using react-leaflet or leaflet with custom dark tiles (e.g., CartoDB Dark Matter or OSM with dark filter).
Highlight the simulated GPS blackout time window with a distinct red shading on both the time-series charts and map trajectory.
Calculate and display exact drift metrics: Drift % = (Final Position Error / Total Distance Traveled during blackout) * 100.
Include simulated live 10 Hz playback animation along the trajectory on the map with step/pause controls.
Ensure ALL interactive elements and key metric text boxes contain data-testid attributes for testing.
